text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race—for now, there were no 
major concerns regarding Vivlos's 
condition. All that was left was to give 
it her all in the main event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the hopes of her fans, the trust 
of her Trainer, and the wish of her sister 
Verxina on her shoulders, Vivlos heads for 
the Oka Sho!
